The SN65DP159 receives high-speed AC-coupled differential video signals and uses receiver equalization and CDR to compensate for losses and jitter introduced by PCB traces and cables.

At lower data rates below approximately 1 Gbps, the device can automatically operate as a redriver. At higher data rates it operates as a retimer, with the CDR restoring the timing of the incoming signal.
The programmable fixed equalization range extends up to 16.5 dB, allowing the device to compensate for different levels of channel loss.
The device provides HDMI 2.0b-compatible TMDS output and supports data rates up to 6 Gbps per lane, sufficient for applications such as 4K × 2K at 60 Hz with 8 bits per color.

A quartz crystal provides both series and parallel resonance. The series resonance is a few kilohertz lower than the parallel one. Crystals below 30 MHz are generally operated between series and parallel resonance, which means that the crystal appears as an inductive reactance in operation, this inductance forming a parallel resonant circuit with externally connected parallel capacitance. Any small additional capacitance in parallel with the crystal will thus pull the frequency downwards. Moreover, the effective inductive reactance of the crystal can be reduced by adding a capacitor in series with the crystal. This latter technique can provide a useful method of trimming the oscillatory frequency within a narrow range; in this case inserting a capacitor in series with the crystal will raise the frequency of oscillation. For a crystal to operate at its specified frequency, the electronic circuit has to be exactly that specified by the crystal manufacturer. Note that these points imply a subtlety concerning crystal oscillators in this frequency range: the crystal does not usually oscillate at precisely either of its resonant frequencies.

Crystals above 30 MHz (up to >200 MHz) are generally operated at series resonance where the impedance appears at its minimum and equal to the series resistance. For these crystals the series resistance is specified (<100 Ω) instead of the parallel capacitance. To reach higher frequencies, a crystal can be made to vibrate at one of its overtone modes, which occur near multiples of the fundamental resonant frequency. Only odd numbered overtones are used. Such a crystal is referred to as a 3rd, 5th, or even 7th overtone crystal. To accomplish this, the oscillator circuit usually includes additional LC circuits to select the desired overtone.

blocks.text: OBD CAN Bus Shield for ESP32 30-Pin Development Board

The OBD CAN Bus Shield is a compact and powerful add-on designed for ESP32 30-pin development boards, enabling automotive diagnostics, OBD-II communication, and CAN bus data monitoring. Built with the 65HVD230 CAN transceiver and NUP2105 CAN bus ESD protection, this shield provides reliable and noise-resistant CAN communication.

The board integrates a 16-pin OBD-II male connector, allowing direct connection to vehicles for real-time data acquisition. It features programmable GPIO26 & GPIO27 LEDs, which can be used to indicate WiFi status, CAN bus activity, or other functions. A built-in DC-DC converter steps down 12V vehicle power to 5V, safely powering the ESP32. Additionally, a voltage divider (1MΩ / 270KΩ) allows the ESP32 to measure vehicle battery voltage via GPIO32.
This shield is compatible with SavvyCAN, ESP32RET, and Arduino CAN bus libraries (such as Arduino TWI), making it ideal for vehicle diagnostics, reverse engineering, and embedded CAN bus projects.

Tips: The necessity of a hydrogen gas detector.

Hydrogen (H2) has the physical properties of colorless and odorless, and the flame is transparent when burned. Therefore, the presence of hydrogen in the environment is not easy to detect by the senses. Generally, Ethyl mercaptan is added to the hydrogen gas so that it can be detected by the senses and make the flame appear color. However, when judging whether hydrogen has leaked, we cannot judge by ignition. Because using an open flame to check hydrogen is tantamount to igniting a time bomb, which is very dangerous. Therefore, it is necessary to use a hydrogen gas detector to monitor the environment where H2 may leak on-line.

Hydrogen is mainly stored in liquid form. The liquid H2 overflows and evaporates suddenly in a large area, which can also cause hypoxia in the environment, and may form an explosive mixture with the air, causing a combustion and explosion accident.

ATO hydrogen gas detector is an instrument that can continuously detect the concentration of H2 in the environment. It uses the natural diffusion method to detect the H2 concentration, with an electrochemical sensor. The use of hydrogen detectors can reduce the occurrence of H2 explosion accidents.

Introduction The LM5072 Powered Device (PD) interface and Pulse-Width-Modulation (PWM) controller provides a complete power solution, fully compliant to IEEE 802.3af, for the PD connecting into Power over Ethernet (PoE) networks. This controller integrates all functions necessary to implement both a PD powered interface and DC-DC converter with a minimum number of external components. The LM5072 provides the flexibility for the PD to also accept power from auxiliary sources such as AC adapters in a variety of configurations. The low RDS(ON) PD interface hot swap MOSFET and programmable DC current limit extend the range of LM5072 applications up to twice the power level of 802.3af compliant PD devices. The 100V maximum voltage rating simplifies selection of the transient voltage suppressor that protects the PD from network transients. The LM5072 includes an easy-to-use PWM controller that facilitates the various single-ended power supply topologies including the flyback, forward and buck. The PWM control scheme is based on peak current mode control, which provides inherent advantages including line feed-forward, cycle-by-cycle current limit, and simplified feedback loop compensation. CH549 is an enhanced E8051 MCU compatible with MCS51 instruction set, 79% of which are single-byte single-cycle instructions, and the average instruction speed is 8 to 15 times faster than that of the standard MCS51. CH549 supports up to 48MHz system clock frequency, ans has built-in 64K program memory Flash-ROM and 256-byte internal iRAM and 2 Kbytes of internal xRAM. And xRAM supports direct memory access (DMA). CH549 has a built-in 12-bit ADC, capacitive touch key detection module, temperature sensor (TS), built-in clock, 3 timers and 3 channels of signal capture, 8 channels of PWM, 4 UARTs, SPI and other functional modules. It supports full-speed and low-speed USB-Host mode and USB-Device mode as well as USB type-C. CH543 is recommended when complete PD function is required.

Core: Enhanced E8051 core compatible with MCS51 command set, 79% of which are single-byte single-cycle commands, and the average command speed is 8 ~ 15 times faster than that of the standard MCS51, with special XRAM data fast copy command, and double DPTR pointers.

ROM: 64KB nonvolatile memory Flash-ROM, supoorts 10K times of erase and program, and can all be used for the program storage space; or it can be divided into a 60KB program storage area, a 1KB data storage area EEPROM and a 3KB BootLoader/ISP program area. EEPROM: 1KB EEPROM, which is divided into 16 independent blocks, supports single-byte read, single-byte write, block write (1 ~ 64 bytes), block erase (64 bytes) operations. In a typical environment, generally it supports 100K times of erase and program (non-guaranteed).
OTP: One-time programmable data storage area, with a total of 32 bytes, and supports double-word read (4 bytes), single-byte write.

RAM: 256-byte internal iRAM, which can be used for fast temporary storage of data and stack; 2KB on-chip xRAM, which can be used for large amount of data temporary storage and DMA direct memory access.

USB: Built-in USB controller and USB transceiver, supports USB-Host mode and USB-Device mode, supports USB 2.0 full speed (12Mbps) and low speed (1.5Mbps) modes, supports data packet of up to 64 bytes, built-in FIFO, and supports DMA.
USB type-C: Support USB type-C master-slave detection, support USB PD power transmission control and 32-bit CRC calculation.
Timer: 3 timers, the standard MCS51 timers T0/T1/T2.
Capture: T2 is extended to support 3-channel signal capture.
PWM: 8-channel PWM output, supports standard 8-bit data or fast 6-bit data.
UART: 4 UARTs, UART0 is a standard MCS51 UART; UART1/2/3 has built-in communication baud rate setting register.

SPI: The SPI controller supports Master/Slave mode, built-in FIFO, clock frequency can be approximate to half of the system clock frequency Fsys. It supports simplex multiplexing of serial data input and output.
ADC: 16-channel 12-bit A/D converter, it supports voltage comparison of multiple combinations.
Touch-key: 16-channel capacitive touch key detection. Each ADC channel supports touch key detection.

The device consists of a resistor array, wiper switches, a control section, and non-volatile memory. The wiper position is controlled by a three-wire interface.

The potentiometer is implemented by a resistor array composed of 99 resistive elements and a wiper switching network. Between each element and at either end are tap points accessible to the wiper terminal.

The nominal output voltage is selected by means of a resistive divider. This makes the device exceptionally easy to use and thereby eliminating the need for stocking of many fixed regulators.

Note: Complete Technical Details can be found at the LM317 datasheet given at the end of this page.

When it comes to variable voltage regulation requirements LM317 would most likely be the first choice. Apart from using it as a variable voltage regulator, it can also be used as a fixed voltage regulator, current limiter, Battery charger, AC voltage regulator and even as an adjustable current regulator. One notable drawback of this IC is that it has a voltage drop of about 2.5 across it during regulation, so if you looking to avoid that problem look into the other equivalent IC’s given above.
So, if you are looking for a variable voltage regulator to deliver current up to 1.5A then this regulator IC might be the right choice for your application.

LM317 is a 3-terminal regulator IC and it is very simple to use. It has many application circuits in its datasheet, but this IC is known for being used as a variable voltage regulator. So, let’s look into how to use this IC as a variable voltage regulator.

As said earlier the IC has 3 pins, in which the input voltage is supplied to pin3 (VIN) then using a pair of resistors (potential divider) we set a voltage at pin 1 (Adjust) which will decide the output voltage of the IC that is given out at pin 2 (VOUT). Now to make it act as a variable voltage regulator we have to set variable voltages at pin 1 which can be done by using a potentiometer in the potential divider. The below circuit is designed to take 12V (you can supply up to 24V) as input and regulate it from 1.25V to 10V.

blocks.text: It is used for many applications like wireless headsets, game controllers, wireless mouse, wireless keyboards, and many more consumer applications.
It is IEEE 802.15.1 standardized protocol, through which one can build wireless Personal Area Network (PAN). It uses frequency-hopping spread spectrum (FHSS) radio technology to send data over air.
It uses serial communication to communicate with devices. It communicates with a microcontroller using serial port (USART).
Voltage: 3.6 V-6 V connected to the VCC pin
Communication leads are working with voltage 3.3 V (tolerate 5 V)
The SPP profile with the possibility to configure via AT commands
Bluetooth serial modules allow all serial-enabled devices to communicate with each other using Bluetooth.

Key/EN: It is used to bring Bluetooth module in AT commands mode. If Key/EN pin is set to high, then this module will work in command mode. Otherwise by default it is in data mode. The default baud rate of HC-05 in command mode is 38400bps and 9600 in data mode. HC-05 module has two modes:
Data mode: Exchange of data between devices.
Command mode: It uses AT commands which are used to change setting of HC-05. To send these commands to module serial (USART) port is used.
VCC: Connect 5 V or 3.3 V to this Pin.
TXD: Transmit Serial data (wirelessly received data by Bluetooth module transmitted out serially on TXD pin)
RXD: Receive data serially (received data will be transmitted wirelessly by Bluetooth module).
State: It tells whether module is connected or not.

HC-05 has red LED which indicates connection status, whether the Bluetooth is connected or not. Before connecting to HC-05 module this red LED blinks continuously in a periodic manner. When it gets connected to any other Bluetooth device, its blinking slows down to two seconds.
This module works on 3.3 V. We can connect 5V supply voltage as well since the module has on board 5 to 3.3 V regulator.

As HC-05 Bluetooth module has 3.3 V level for RX/TX and microcontroller can detect 3.3 V level, so, no need to shift transmit level of HC-05 module. But we need to shift the transmit voltage level from microcontroller to RX of HC-05 module.
Search for new Bluetooth device from your phone. You will find Bluetooth device with “HC-05” name.
Click on connect/pair device option; default pin for HC-05 is 1234 or 0000

After pairing two Bluetooth devices, open terminal software (e.g. Teraterm, Realterm etc.) in PC, and select the port where we have connected USB to serial module. Also select default baud rate of 9600 bps.
In smart phone, open Bluetooth terminal application and connect to paired device HC-05.

It is simple to communicate, we just have to type in the Bluetooth terminal application of smartphone. Characters will get sent wirelessly to Bluetooth module HC-05. HC-05 will automatically transmit it serially to the PC, which will appear on terminal. Same way we can send data from PC to smartphone.
When we want to change settings of HC-05 Bluetooth module like change password for connection, baud rate, Bluetooth device’s name etc.
To do this, HC-05 has AT commands.
To use HC-05 Bluetooth module in AT command mode, connect “Key” pin to High (VCC).
Default Baud rate of HC-05 in command mode is 38400bps.
Following are some AT command generally used to change setting of Bluetooth module.
To send these commands, we have to connect HC-05 Bluetooth module to the PC via serial to USB converter and transmit these command through serial terminal of PC.

blocks.v: Set Bluetooth Device Name e.g. AT+NAME=MyHC-05 · OK

blocks.v: Change Baud rate e.g. AT+UART=9600,1,0 · OK

blocks.text: General Purpose Low current and Low voltage NPN Transistor

BC549 is an NPN transistor hence the collector and emitter will be left open (Reverse biased) when the base pin is held at ground and will be closed (Forward biased) when a signal is provided to the base pin. It is a low-current transistor hence the maximum amount of current that could flow through the Collector pin (Ic) is 100mA, hence we cannot connect loads that consume more than 100mA and load voltage of more than 30V using this transit. BC549 has a decent gain value of from 420 to 800; this value determines the amplification capacity of the transistor.

When this transistor is fully biased it can allow a maximum of 100mA to flow across the collector and emitter. This stage is called the Saturation Region. When the base current is removed the transistor becomes fully off, this stage is called the Cut-off Region.

The BC549 has a very low Continuous current of 100mA hence it cannot be used to switch heavy loads. But since it has a base trigger voltage of only 5V it can be easily controlled through 5V GPIO pins of Microcontrollers and Microprocessors. So it can be used in places where the load current is less than 100mA.
Apart from that the transistor can be used as an amplifier since it has a gain value from 420 to 800 and a transition frequency of 10MHz

blocks.text: Voltage regulators are very common in electronic circuits. They provide a constant output voltage for a varied input voltage. In our case, the 7809 IC is an iconic regulator IC that finds its application in most of the projects. The name 7809 signifies two meanings, “78” means that it is a positive voltage regulator, and “09” means that it provides 9V as output. So our 7809 will provide a +9V output voltage.

The output current of this IC can go up to 1.5A. However, the IC suffers from heavy heat loss hence a Heatsink is recommended for projects that consume more current. For example, if the input voltage is 15V and you are consuming 1A, then (15-9) * 1 = 6W. This 6 Watts will be dissipated as heat.

Users can set a target temperature range, and the controller will activate either the heating or cooling relay as needed to maintain that range.

Its panel-mount design allows for easy installation in control panels, DIY systems, or custom enclosures. With its built-in transformer, it simplifies wiring and eliminates the need for an external power supply, especially in 220V setups.

makers-494782.summary: SRM8 is a compact 8-channel serial relay board using a shift-register interface (SPI) — expands microcontroller outputs with daisy-chainable relays, wide supply range (5–40V) and screw-terminal wiring.

blocks.text: SRM8 is an 8-channel relay module designed to allow expanding microcontroller I/O pins. SRM8 is based on the 8-bit shift register 74595 IC. It supports 8 output relays while using only three I/Os. SRM8 can be daisy-chained to further extend the outputs to theoretically an infinite number while still using the same three microcontroller I/O pins.

SRM8 module can be supplied from a wide range of voltages (5-40V). The input control signals are Digital Input (DI), Clock (CK), and Load (LD). Every time the shift register Clock input receives a low to high transition it accepts the data input value to bit0 and shifts the internal register data by one bit. Thus, 8 clock pulses are required to get one-byte data from the microcontroller. Finally, a latch pulse is required to load all internal shift register data to parallel outputs (Relays). This control sequence can be performed using a hardware-implemented SPI or a few lines of written code.

makers-483210.summary: Digital CO sensor (RS-COWS-N01-2-2000P-5) with RS-485 / Modbus output, measures CO, temperature, humidity, for continuous environmental monitoring

blocks.text: Carbon Monoxide (CO) Gas Sensor RS-COWS-N01-2-2000P-5 RS485

The RS-COWS-N01-2-2000P-5 (RS485) is a smart CO gas transmitter combining gas, temperature and humidity sensing in one unit. It comes in a rugged, sealed enclosure to shield internal sensors from dust, moisture, and environmental stress. Its compact and modular design enables installation on walls or panels in industrial or building control contexts, with the ability to network multiple units via the RS-485 bus.

When powered (10–30 V DC), the unit initializes and stabilizes, then begins measuring ambient CO concentration, ambient temperature, and humidity at periodic intervals (every 2 seconds). The measurements are digitized and sent over RS-485 using the Modbus-RTU protocol. This digital communication mitigates the signal degradation and noise susceptibility that often affects analogue transmissions over distance.

In a networked monitoring system, multiple units can share a common RS-485 line, each with a unique address. The central controller (PLC, SCADA, BMS) polls each sensor for its current readings and can trigger actions (ventilation, alarms) based on threshold crossings. The integrated multi-parameter sensing in one package simplifies deployment and wiring, making it suitable for continuous environmental safety monitoring in parking garages, mechanical rooms, laboratories, or HVAC zones.

makers-422446.summary: BT138-600 is a 600V, 12A Triac in a TO-220 package, ideal for AC power control like dimming, motor speed regulation, and switching applications.

blocks.text: The BT138-600 Triac is a robust and versatile semiconductor device designed for controlling power in AC circuits. Rated at 600 volts and 12 amps, this triac is housed in a TO-220 through-hole package, making it ideal for a wide range of applications that involve switching or phase control of alternating current.

As a bidirectional device, the BT138-600 can conduct current in both directions when triggered, which is essential for AC power control. It is frequently used in light dimmers, motor speed controllers, heater control systems, and AC switching circuits. The 600V rating ensures safe operation under standard line voltages with sufficient overhead for transients, while the 12A current capability makes it suitable for medium-power applications.

One of the key advantages of the BT138-600 is its sensitive gate triggering, which allows it to be activated with low gate current. This means it can be controlled directly by low-power logic-level devices like microcontrollers or Optoisolator, enabling easy integration into smart control systems. The low gate current requirement also contributes to reduced heat generation and more efficient operation.

The TO-220 package offers excellent heat dissipation characteristics, thanks to its metal tab, which can be mounted to a heatsink for additional thermal management in high-power applications. This ensures the triac remains cool and reliable even under demanding load conditions.

Moreover, the BT138-600 provides high immunity to dv/dt (rate of voltage change), which helps prevent false triggering in noisy environments—an important feature for industrial and home automation systems.

Overall, the BT138-600 is a cost-effective, durable, and easy-to-use triac that combines high voltage and current handling capabilities with reliable switching performance. Whether you’re building a dimmer circuit or an advanced microcontroller-based control unit, the BT138-600 is a solid choice for efficient AC power control.
Easy AC Power Control: The BT138-600 lets you switch and control AC power effortlessly, making it perfect for dimming lights, controlling motor speeds, and heating systems.
Works Both Ways: As a bidirectional device, it can handle current in both directions, ideal for alternating current (AC) circuits.

Stable in Noisy Environments: Engineered to resist false triggering, it performs reliably even in environments with electrical noise or fast voltage changes.

makers-389303.summary: LM2406T High voltage triple CRT driver IC with 9ns rise/fall time designed to directly drive RGB cathodes in color monitor applications up to 80MHz pixel clock.

blocks.text: LM2406T Monolithic Triple 9ns CRT Driver IC

The LM2406 is a high-voltage integrated CRT driver circuit intended specifically for colour monitor applications. The IC is made up of three wide-band amplifiers with high input impedance that drive the RGB cathodes of a CRT directly. Each channel’s gain is set to 14.5 internally, allowing it to drive CRT capacitive loads as well as resistive loads supplied by other applications, with the package’s power consumption being the sole constraint. The IC is housed in an 11-lead TO-220 molded plastic power package, which is industry standard. This high-voltage monolithic triple CRT driver is ideal for use with VGA and SVGA displays.

LM2406 also works at 80V and has a low power dissipation. The LM2406 has a wide bandwidth amplifier function that necessitates correct power supply bypassing for optimal operation. Large overshoot, ringing, and oscillation can occur if the power source is bypassed improperly. Internal arcing can happen on a CRT during regular operation. The maximum voltage will be limited by spark gaps of 200V–300V at the cathodes, but only to a value that is significantly higher than the LM2406 allows. In the meanwhile, the LM2406 is not utilized without a heat sink. This is because when the input signal rises, the power supply current increases, and as a result, power dissipation increases.

The BC177 Transistor is a general-purpose PNP transistor, A PNP junction transistor is a sandwiched construction of P-type material with an N-type material in the middle. Depending upon the construction transistors are divided into two categories NPN transistor and PNP transistor, which are shown below.

The BC177 transistor is a very versatile transistor that can be used in many different applications. It is basically used when you want a simple switching device for low power loads, simultaneously it can be used in high-frequency RF applications, its gain-bandwidth product and its metal construction make it suitable for many different applications. The component is cheap and easy to work with so it is best suited when choosing a random switching device. BC177 can also be used as a basic power amplifier and its application includes amplifying low power signals.

When this transistor is in a biased condition, then it can allow a maximum current of -200mA across CE(Collector-Emitter) Junction, this state of the transistor is called the saturation state, and driving a load that consumes more current than 200mA may damage the device permanently. As you already may know a transistor is a current-controlled device so when the base current is removed the transistor becomes fully off, in this stage the transistor is working in its Cut-off Region and no current flows through the C-E junction. The BC177 Transistor has a gain of 125 to 500 this value determines the amplification capacity of the transistor, the peak current that can be flown through this transistor is 200maA, which is combined with the gain value makes this transistor a perfect choice for RF applications.
How to use BC177 Transistor in a Circuit

Transistors are current-controlled devices so to turn them on a little current is needed. For the BC177 Transistor, this base current is less than 10mA, as BC177 is a PNP transistor that means it will be on when the base is connected to the ground, and it will be off when a positive voltage is applied to the base of the transistor.
The simulated circuit below shows how this transistor behaves when the base of the basic circuit is connected to the ground and when it’s connected to 5V of the power supply.

When we turn on the transistor by connecting the base to the ground the transistor will remain on unless the voltage at the base of the transistor reaches more than the base turn-off voltage, for this transistor, it is somewhere in between 0.7 -0.9V. The base of the transistor cannot be left floating otherwise there could be false triggering, which may lead to issues in the circuit. To resolve the issue we need to add pullup resistors as shown in the example, a 10K resistor is used to pull up the base of the transistor to VCC.

blocks.text: MOC3042 Zero-Cross Optoisolator Triac Driver 6 Pin

The MOC3042 Zero-Cross Optoisolators Triac Driver 6 Pin is a zero-cross optoisolator triac driver this Meaning it has a Infra-red Light Emitting Diode (LED) inside it coupled with a TRIAC. When the LED is triggered the TRIAC is also turned on and designed for interfacing low-voltage control circuits with high-voltage AC loads. It integrates a gallium arsenide infrared emitting diode (IRED) that optically triggers a silicon bilateral switch triac, providing safe electrical isolation between input and output. The zero-crossing feature ensures switching occurs only when the AC load voltage is near zero, minimizing electrical noise, reducing inrush current, and improving overall system reliability. Packaged in a compact 6-pin DIP, the MOC3042 is widely used in AC load switching, solid-state relays, lamp dimmers, and motor control applications, offering high safety and efficient performance in industrial and consumer electronics.

Its square frame (60 mm on each side) with a 25 mm depth gives space for fairly large blades and a robust flow of air without making the fan too bulky. The fan’s motor is housed inside a plastic frame that holds the blade assembly and allows mounting on panels or inside devices. Because of its moderate size, it strikes a balance: small enough to fit inside mid-sized boxes or spaces, large enough to provide reasonable airflow.

When powered at 5 V, the fan draws its rated current to spin the blades and generate airflow that helps cool circuit boards, power supplies, or other heat sources inside the enclosure. The fan blades are designed to push air through the frame; airflow direction is typically from the front to the back face. As the blades rotate, there is some sound and vibration, though good design (balanced blades, proper bearings) keeps noise modest. The fan operates continuously when supplied, and its performance depends on factors like ambient temperature, airflow obstruction, and cleanliness (dust or debris can degrade performance over time).

Because of its 5 V rating, this fan is well suited to devices using USB power, small DC supplies, battery-powered systems, or microcontroller setups. The plastic frame, while lightweight, still offers durability for many uses, though impacts and mechanical stress should be minimized. With appropriate mounting (screws, vibration damping), the fan can run for many thousands of hours. In summary, this fan type offers a useful trade-off: good air movement, moderate noise, manageable power draw, and compatibility with low-voltage systems.

blocks.text: Arduino PRO NICLA SENSE ME (Designed / Assembled in Italy)

Arduino PRO NICLA SENSE ME (Designed / Assembled in Italy) is the smallest board developed by Arduino equipped with a range of the latest Bosch environmental and motion sensors. The module is based on the nRF52832 ARM Cortex M4 chip clocked at 64 MHz with 512 kB of Flash memory, 64 kB of RAM and 2 MB of SPI Flash and 2 MB of QSPI embedded memory. The Nicla Sense ME features the Bosch BHI260AP, BMP390, BMM150, and BME688 embedded sensors. Bluetooth LE 4.2 is responsible for wireless communication and with the use of a Li-Pol battery, the module can work as a standalone device.

BHI260AP. Intelligent sensor equipped with artificial intelligence (AI) with 6-axis IMU (3-axis accelerometer + 3-axis gyroscope) for motion detection, powered by Synopsys DesignWare ARC EM4 32-bit processor.
BMP390. High performance pressure sensor with a range from 300 hPa to 1250 hPa with low drift.
BMM150. A low-noise magnetometer measuring ± 1300 μT in the X, Y axes and ± 2500 μT in the Z axis.

BME688. Environmental sensor measuring pressure, temperature and humidity. It also features an intelligent gas sensor that helps determine the air quality index by detecting a wide range of gases, including volatile organic compounds (VOCs).

Designed to easily analyze motion and the surrounding environment – hence the “M” and “E” in the name – it measures rotation, acceleration, pressure, humidity, temperature, air quality and CO2 levels by introducing completely new Bosch Sensortec sensors on the market.

Its tiny size and robust design make it suitable for projects that need to combine sensor fusion and AI capabilities on the edge, thanks to a strong computational power and low-consumption combination that can even lead to standalone applications when battery operated.

Part of Arduino Pro’s new Nicla family of modular, intelligent products that are easy to use, cost effective, versatile and accessible, the Sense ME has a new, tiny form factor that is also compatible with the Arduino MKR and Portenta ranges.

blocks.text: The 74HC595 is a very handy IC used in many microcontroller projects. You clock in 8 bits of data (like, on/off settings for 8 LEDs) via two lines, and when you toggle a third line, it pops these settings out on 8 outputs on the IC. So you trade 3 valuable lines on your microcontroller for 8 outputs – a pretty good deal, eh?

This is called “Shifting data out” of the microcontroller by “synchronous serial communication”. This is the serial part of the deal, where each bit is “shifted in” one at a time, then BOOM, they all appear at once (in parallel) on the chip’s output.
There are some great tutorials on how to use a shift register. Here’s one for the Arduino microcontroller, but the technique holds true for pretty much all microcontrollers!
It is a shift register with 8-bit serial input and 8-bit serial or 3-state parallel outputs.

blocks.text: The TIP41C is a robust NPN bipolar power transistor produced using base-island technology and supplied in a TO-220 plastic package. Its mechanical construction prioritizes good thermal contact between the semiconductor die and the package backplate, allowing efficient heat transfer when attached to a heatsink. The device’s leadframe and encapsulation are designed for mechanical durability and straightforward PCB mounting, and the TO-220 form factor makes it easy to handle and replace in discrete assemblies.

At the semiconductor level the TIP41C uses a conventional bipolar layout optimized to manage moderate collector currents while keeping leakage and saturation behavior under control. The internal layout and manufacturing choices reduce parasitic elements, improving linearity and stabilizing switching response under normal drive conditions. The die/package combination balances thermal performance and compactness for typical discrete power circuits.

From an integrator’s viewpoint the offers a practical compromise between ruggedness and simplicity: compact enough for small assemblies yet able to tolerate repeated thermal cycling when properly mounted. Its documented mechanical data and standardized pinout simplify thermal-management decisions and system assembly. Documented by STMicroelectronics, the device follows common datasheet conventions and quality practices.

blocks.text: WAGO F12 Wire Connector 1 In 2 Out – Compact Spring Lever Distribution Connector
WAGO F12 Wire Connector 1 In 2 Out

The WAGO F12 Wire Connector is a practical and compact solution for electrical installations that require one incoming wire to be distributed into two outgoing lines safely and neatly. With its 1 input and 2 output configuration, this connector is especially useful for branch wiring, parallel distribution, and organized cable routing in compact electrical setups.

This WAGO wire connector uses a spring lever clamping mechanism, allowing wires to be inserted and locked quickly without twisting, soldering, or using screw terminals. This makes installation faster, reduces wiring effort, and simplifies future maintenance or rewiring. Each conductor is clamped individually, which helps provide secure wire holding and stable long-term electrical contact.

The WAGO F12 is suitable for solid, stranded, and flexible conductors, making it practical for lighting circuits, distribution points, junction boxes, switchboards, control systems, low-voltage installations, and general electrical projects. Its compact body helps save space while keeping the wiring layout clean and organized.

The housing is made from insulating material suitable for practical electrical use. The connector is designed for reliable low-voltage electrical performance and convenient repeated use when wiring changes are needed. It is commonly available with orange lever handles, depending on stock and production batch.

If you need a compact distribution connector that combines quick lever operation, reusable design, secure wire grip, and simple 1-to-2 branching, the WAGO F12 is a practical choice for many electrical wiring applications.

يعتمد هذا موصل WAGO على آلية تثبيت برافعة زنبركية، وهي طريقة سهلة وسريعة في تركيب الأسلاك مقارنة بطرق التوصيل التقليدية. يتم رفع الرافعة، ثم إدخال السلك بعد تجريده، ثم غلق الرافعة للحصول على تثبيت محكم واتصال كهربائي ثابت، بدون الحاجة إلى لف الأسلاك أو لحامها أو استخدام مسامير ربط. وهذا يسهّل التركيب، ويقلل وقت العمل، ويجعل أعمال الصيانة أو إعادة التوصيل أكثر راحة.

يدعم WAGO F12 أنواعًا متعددة من الأسلاك، بما في ذلك الأسلاك الصلبة والمجدولة والمرنة، مما يجعله مناسبًا لتطبيقات كثيرة مثل دوائر الإضاءة، وصناديق التوصيل، ونقاط التوزيع، ولوحات التحكم، والمشاريع المنزلية، والتوصيلات الكهربائية منخفضة الجهد. كما أن حجمه المدمج يساعد على توفير مساحة مع الحفاظ على شكل مرتب ومنظم للأسلاك.
جسم الموصل مصنوع من خامة عازلة مناسبة للاستخدام الكهربائي العملي، ويأتي هذا الموديل غالبًا بمقابض باللون البرتقالي حسب النسخة المعروضة، مع ثبات نفس الوظيفة الأساسية والمواصفات العامة.

إذا كنت تحتاج إلى موصل أسلاك WAGO عملي لتوزيع خط واحد إلى مخرجين بشكل سريع وآمن ومنظم، فإن WAGO F12 يقدم لك حلًا مناسبًا يجمع بين سهولة الاستخدام، وثبات التوصيل، وإمكانية إعادة الاستخدام، والحجم العملي.

blocks.text: TOTAL Soldering Gun 90W with Self-Feeding Solder TET160732

The TOTAL TET160732 is a compact 90 W soldering gun with an integrated self-feeding solder wire system that lets you keep one hand on the work and one on the trigger—ideal for quick joints on wiring, connectors, PCB pads, and small assemblies. A ceramic heating element delivers fast, stable heat with a ~20-second preheat, while the straight tip head and rotary/thermostatic temperature control give you smooth, predictable flow across a wide set of soldering tasks. Whether you’re repairing appliances, building DIY projects, or doing field fixes, the TET160732 speeds up the job and cuts fumbling with loose solder.

blocks.text: 280 Diaphragm Micro Pump 3.7V Self-Priming Mini Vacuum Water Pump

The 280 Diaphragm Micro Pump 3.7V Self-Priming Mini Pump is a compact and efficient micro pump built for applications that need lightweight liquid transfer or suction in a small form factor. Despite its small size, this pump delivers practical performance with self-priming capability, making it useful for many electronics and mechanical projects where space is limited.

This pump can serve multiple functions depending on how it is connected in the system. It can be used as a diaphragm pump, water pump, suction pump, or small vacuum pump, which makes it a versatile option for makers, hobbyists, and product developers. It is especially suitable for experimental setups, compact dispensing systems, tea and beverage machines, small cleaning systems, model projects, and other low-voltage pumping tasks.

Operating from 3V to 4.5V DC, the pump provides a flow rate of approximately 48 to 72 liters per hour, with a suction limit of up to 2 meters and a maximum head of about 1.5 meters. This makes it suitable for light-duty transfer and suction applications rather than high-pressure or heavy continuous-use systems.

The pump is designed with low power consumption and high efficiency, helping it work well in battery-powered projects and compact embedded systems. It uses a diaphragm-based pumping mechanism, which supports stable fluid handling for clean liquids in appropriate applications.

This model is not submersible, so it must be used outside the liquid. It is also important not to run the pump dry for long periods and not to test it without load for too long, as dry running may damage the internal plastic blades and reduce service life. Because of its internal structure, the pump should be used with relatively clean liquids and not with impurities or particles that may damage the rotor or internal components.

تُعد مضخة 280 ديافرام الصغيرة 3.7 فولت خيارًا عمليًا للمشروعات التي تحتاج إلى مضخة صغيرة الحجم وقادرة على تنفيذ مهام الضخ أو الشفط بكفاءة مناسبة. ورغم حجمها الصغير، فإنها تقدم أداءً جيدًا مع خاصية التحضير الذاتي، مما يجعلها مناسبة للعديد من التطبيقات التي تتطلب تركيبًا مدمجًا ومساحة محدودة.

يمكن استخدام هذه المضخة بعدة طرق حسب طريقة التوصيل داخل النظام، فهي تصلح كمضخة ديافرام، أو مضخة مياه، أو مضخة شفط، أو مضخة تفريغ صغيرة، وهو ما يجعلها خيارًا مرنًا للهواة والمهندسين ومطوري النماذج الأولية. وهي مناسبة بشكل خاص للتجارب العملية، وأنظمة توزيع السوائل الصغيرة، وماكينات الشاي أو المشروبات، وأنظمة التنظيف الخفيفة، والنماذج التعليمية، ومشروعات نقل السوائل منخفضة الجهد.

تعمل المضخة على جهد من 3 إلى 4.5 فولت تيار مستمر، وتوفر معدل تدفق يقارب 48 إلى 72 لترًا في الساعة، مع قدرة شفط حتى 2 متر وارتفاع دفع أقصى حوالي 1.5 متر. لذلك فهي مناسبة لتطبيقات الضخ والشفط الخفيفة، وليست مخصصة للضغط العالي أو التشغيل الشاق المستمر.

تتميز هذه المضخة باستهلاك منخفض للطاقة وكفاءة جيدة، مما يجعلها مناسبة للمشروعات التي تعمل بالبطاريات أو الأنظمة الإلكترونية الصغيرة. كما تعتمد على آلية ضخ بالديافرام، ما يساعد على التعامل مع السوائل النظيفة بشكل ثابت في التطبيقات المناسبة.

ويجب الانتباه إلى أن هذه المضخة غير مغمورة، أي لا يجب وضعها داخل الماء أو السائل أثناء التشغيل. كما يجب عدم تشغيلها جافة لفترات طويلة، وعدم اختبارها بدون حمل لمدة طويلة، لأن ذلك قد يسبب تلفًا في الأجزاء الداخلية البلاستيكية ويؤثر على عمرها التشغيلي. وبسبب تركيبتها الداخلية، يفضل استخدامها مع سوائل نظيفة نسبيًا وخالية من الشوائب أو الجزيئات التي قد تضر بالمكونات الداخلية.

blocks.text: Relay 8 Channel 5V Module with Optocoupler Isolation – 10A Relay Board for Arduino, Raspberry Pi & Automation

The 8 Channel 5V Relay Module with Optocoupler Isolation is a practical and powerful interface board used to switch multiple electrical loads safely through low-voltage control systems. It is designed for makers, students, engineers, technicians, and automation developers who need an easy and dependable way to control relays from popular development boards and embedded systems.

This module provides 8 independent relay outputs, allowing a single control board to manage several devices at the same time. It can be driven directly by many microcontroller platforms such as Arduino, Raspberry Pi, AVR, PIC, ARM, and STM32 boards, making it suitable for both educational and professional applications.

One of the major advantages of this board is its optocoupler isolation, which helps separate the control side from the relay power side. This improves safety, reduces electrical interference, and helps protect sensitive controller circuits from noise and switching disturbances. Because of this, the module is well-suited for automation systems where stable and secure switching is important.

Each relay channel supports a load of up to 10A at 250VAC or 10A at 30VDC, making this board suitable for a wide range of switching applications including lighting control, motors, pumps, solenoids, fans, alarms, home automation devices, and other electrical equipment. The board uses low-level triggering, which makes it easy to activate each relay using standard digital outputs from 3.3V or 5V logic systems.

The module is also equipped with status indicator LEDs for each channel, allowing the user to monitor relay activity quickly during testing and operation. The onboard JD-VCC jumper gives flexibility in relay coil power configuration, while the standard 2.54mm pin spacing allows convenient connection using jumper wires and development cables.

This 5V 8 channel relay board is an excellent choice for users building smart switching circuits, industrial test systems, home control panels, automated prototypes, learning projects, and multi-load control applications where reliable isolation and simple wiring are required.

تُعد وحدة ريليه 8 قناة 5 فولت مع عزل ضوئي Optocoupler من الوحدات العملية جدًا للتحكم في عدة أحمال كهربائية باستخدام إشارات منخفضة الجهد من المتحكمات الدقيقة ولوحات التطوير. تم تصميم هذه اللوحة لتمنح المستخدم طريقة سهلة وآمنة لتشغيل وفصل الأجهزة الكهربائية المختلفة من خلال أنظمة تحكم مثل Arduino وRaspberry Pi وSTM32 وAVR وPIC وARM وغيرها.

توفر هذه الوحدة 8 مخارج ريليه مستقلة، مما يسمح بالتحكم في أكثر من جهاز في نفس الوقت باستخدام لوحة واحدة. ولذلك فهي مناسبة جدًا للمشاريع التي تحتاج إلى تشغيل عدة دوائر أو أجهزة بشكل منفصل ومنظم، مثل أنظمة الإضاءة، والمضخات، والمراوح، والمحركات، وأجهزة الإنذار، وأنظمة التحكم الذكية.

من أهم مميزات هذه اللوحة أنها مزودة بعزل ضوئي Optocoupler، وهو ما يساعد على فصل دائرة التحكم عن دائرة تشغيل الريليه. هذا الفصل يقلل من تأثير التشويش الكهربائي ويحسن مستوى الأمان ويحمي دوائر التحكم الحساسة من الإشارات غير المرغوبة أو تأثير الأحمال أثناء التشغيل والفصل.

كل قناة من قنوات الريليه قادرة على تحمل حتى 10 أمبير عند 250 فولت AC أو 10 أمبير عند 30 فولت DC، مما يجعلها مناسبة لعدد كبير من تطبيقات التحكم الكهربائي. كما أن الوحدة تعمل بنظام التفعيل بالمستوى المنخفض Low Level Trigger، وهو ما يسهل تشغيلها مباشرة من المخارج الرقمية لمعظم المتحكمات التي تعمل بجهد 3.3 فولت أو 5 فولت.

اللوحة مزودة أيضًا بمؤشرات LED لكل قناة، مما يساعد على متابعة حالة التشغيل بسهولة أثناء البرمجة أو الاختبار أو التشغيل الفعلي. كما أن وجود جامبر JD-VCC يمنح مرونة في إعداد تغذية ملف الريليه، بينما تساعد البيّنات القياسية 2.54 مم على سهولة التوصيل باستخدام الأسلاك والجامبرات الشائعة.
إذا كنت تبحث عن لوحة ريليه 8 قناة 5 فولت لمشروع تحكم أو أتمتة أو تشغيل أحمال متعددة من خلال متحكم دقيق، فإن هذه الوحدة توفر لك أداءً عمليًا واعتمادية جيدة وسهولة كبيرة في الاستخدام والتوصيل.

FQPF4N60 موسفت قدرة قناة N بجهد 600 فولت في باكيدج TO-220F المعزول، تيار 2.6 أمبير وقدرة تبديد 36 وات، بشحنة بوابة 15 نانو كولوم وتبديل سريع (45 نانو ثانية) وسعة خرج 70 بيكو فاراد.

blocks.text: FQPF4N60 600V N-Channel Power MOSFET (Enhancement Mode) – TO-220F

The FQPF4N60 is a high-voltage N-channel power MOSFET designed for stable and efficient switching in power control circuits. With a 600V drain-to-source voltage rating and up to 2.6A drain current, it is commonly used in offline power stages, high-voltage DC switching, and compact SMPS designs where dependable high-voltage performance is required.

This MOSFET supports 36W maximum power dissipation, making it suitable for moderate-power applications when proper heatsinking and PCB copper area are considered. It also features a low total gate charge (Qg = 15nC) which helps reduce gate-drive losses and improves overall switching efficiency. Fast switching behavior is supported by a 45ns rise time, while a low output capacitance (Coss = 70pF) helps minimize switching stress and improves transient response in high-voltage converter designs.

With RDS(on) up to 2.2Ω (maximum), the device provides predictable conduction performance for high-voltage switching tasks. It also supports ±30V gate-source voltage and a 150°C maximum junction temperature, ensuring reliable operation in demanding thermal environments. The device comes in an insulated TO-220F package, offering practical mounting and electrical isolation benefits for power applications.
FQPF4N60 موسفت قدرة قناة N – 600 فولت – باكيدج TO-220F (تشغيل بالتعزيز)

يُعد FQPF4N60 ترانزستور MOSFET قدرة قناة N مصمم للعمل بكفاءة داخل دوائر التبديل والتحكم في القدرة ذات الجهد العالي. يتميز بتحمل جهد حتى 600 فولت بين المصرف والمصدر مع تيار مصرف أقصى 2.6 أمبير، مما يجعله مناسبًا لتطبيقات مثل مزودات الطاقة الأوفلاين، دوائر التبديل عالية الجهد، وتصميمات SMPS المدمجة التي تحتاج مكوّنًا يعتمد عليه في تحمل الجهد.

يوفر الموسفت قدرة تبديد قصوى 36 وات (وفق ظروف التبريد والتركيب)، لذلك يناسب تطبيقات القدرة المتوسطة عند استخدام تبريد جيد وتصميم PCB مناسب. كما أن شحنة البوابة المنخفضة (Qg = 15 نانو كولوم) تساعد على تقليل فاقد قيادة البوابة وتحسين كفاءة التبديل. ويدعم أداء تبديل سريع بفضل زمن صعود 45 نانو ثانية، مع سعة خرج منخفضة (Coss = 70 بيكو فاراد) تقلل إجهاد التبديل وتحسن الاستجابة العابرة في دوائر محولات الجهد العالي.

تصل مقاومة التشغيل RDS(on) إلى 2.2 أوم كحد أقصى، لتقديم أداء توصيل متوقع في مهام التبديل عالية الجهد. كما يدعم جهد بوابة حتى ±30 فولت ودرجة حرارة وصلة قصوى 150°م لثبات أعلى في ظروف التشغيل الصعبة. يأتي في باكيدج TO-220F المعزول الذي يوفر ميزة العزل الكهربائي وسهولة التركيب في تطبيقات القدرة.

blocks.text: OSEPP Barrel Jack to 2 Pin JST Cable LS-00012

The OSEPP Barrel Jack to 2 Pin JST Cable is a practical adapter cable designed to connect a standard DC barrel power source to devices or boards that use a 2-pin JST connector. This type of cable is especially useful in electronics projects, battery charging setups, development boards, compact modules, and embedded systems where a quick and reliable power conversion lead is needed. The uploaded drawing identifies the assembly as a DC 5.5 × 2.1 mm female barrel connector to 2-pin JST lead, with a cable length of approximately 160 ± 5 mm.

This OSEPP Barrel Jack to 2 Pin JST Cable provides a convenient way to interface wall adapters, DC power supplies, and compatible barrel plug sources with compact JST-based inputs. It helps eliminate the need for custom soldering in many low-voltage power projects and makes power distribution cleaner and easier during prototyping or product assembly. The cable drawing and part breakdown on page 1 show a complete assembly including the DC socket, 2-pin JST housing, JST terminals, heat-shrink sleeve, and 2-core cable.

Because the OSEPP Barrel Jack to 2 Pin JST Cable combines two common connector styles, it is useful for powering sensors, charging small battery packs, supplying development boards, and adapting external DC sources to modules that use JST connectors. The uploaded file also shows the conductor mapping: red wire to pin 1 and black wire to pin 2, which is important when using the cable in power-sensitive electronics applications.

The assembly uses a compact inline design that is easy to route inside projects and enclosures. The drawing notes a cable based on UL2464 24 AWG 2-core wire, black outer cable, and a short heat-shrink section near the JST side, which supports durability and insulation in normal project use. The additional pages in the datasheet provide mechanical references for the DC socket, JST terminal, and JST 2-pin housing used in the cable assembly.

If you need a simple power adapter lead to connect a DC wall supply to a 2-pin JST-equipped board or charging interface, the OSEPP Barrel Jack to 2 Pin JST Cable is a useful and tidy solution for workshop, educational, and embedded electronics applications.

وصلة باريل جاك إلى جي اس تي ثنائي

تُعد وصلة باريل جاك إلى جي اس تي ثنائي كابل توصيل عملي مخصص لتحويل مصدر طاقة بمدخل باريل جاك قياسي إلى خرج بفيشة جي اس تي ثنائية، مما يجعلها مناسبة لتغذية كثير من اللوحات الإلكترونية والموديولات الصغيرة ودوائر الشحن والمشروعات العملية. وتوضح الداتا شيت المرفوعة أن هذا المنتج عبارة عن وصلة من مقبس تيار مستمر 5.5 × 2.1 مم إلى فيشة جي اس تي ثنائية بطول تقريبي 160 ± 5 مم.

توفر وصلة باريل جاك إلى جي اس تي ثنائي طريقة سهلة ونظيفة لتوصيل محولات الحائط أو مصادر الجهد المستمر باللوحات أو الوحدات التي تعتمد على مدخل جي اس تي ثنائي. وهذا يقلل الحاجة إلى تنفيذ توصيلات يدوية أو لحام مباشر في كثير من المشروعات، كما يجعل إعداد التغذية أكثر ترتيبًا داخل العلبة أو أثناء التجارب على منضدة العمل. وتوضح الرسمة الرئيسية في الصفحة الأولى مكونات التجميعة بالكامل، وتشمل جاك التيار، والكونكتور الثنائي، والطرفين المعدنيين، وقطعة الانكماش الحراري، والكابل الثنائي.

تُعتبر وصلة باريل جاك إلى جي اس تي ثنائي مناسبة جدًا لتغذية الموديولات الصغيرة، ودوائر الشحن، ولوحات التطوير، وبعض تطبيقات البطاريات، والمشروعات التعليمية، خصوصًا عند الحاجة إلى وصلة جاهزة بين مصدر طاقة خارجي وكونكتور جي اس تي. كما توضح الداتا شيت ترتيب الأسلاك، حيث إن السلك الأحمر متصل بالطرف 1 والسلك الأسود متصل بالطرف 2، وهي نقطة مهمة عند استخدام المنتج مع دوائر حساسة للقطبية.

يأتي الكابل بتصميم خطي مدمج يسهل تمريره داخل المشروعات والصناديق الإلكترونية. كما تشير الداتا شيت إلى استخدام سلك ثنائي 24 AWG مع غلاف خارجي أسود وقطعة حماية حرارية قرب ناحية الكونكتور، مما يساعد على تحسين المتانة والعزل في الاستخدام المعتاد. وتحتوي الصفحات الأخرى من الملف على رسومات ميكانيكية خاصة بجاك التيار والطرف المعدني والفيشة الثنائية المستخدمة في هذه التجميعة.

إذا كنت تحتاج إلى وصلة جاهزة لتوصيل مصدر طاقة بباريل جاك مع لوحة أو دائرة تستخدم جي اس تي ثنائي، فإن وصلة باريل جاك إلى جي اس تي ثنائي تعتبر خيارًا عمليًا ومفيدًا لأعمال الورش والتجارب والتغذية منخفضة الجهد.

blocks.text: Rotary Encoder 5pins + Push Button — Black Knurled Shaft, No Threaded Bushing

The Pot Rotary Encoder SW 5p + PB is a rotary encoder with an integrated push button and a total of 5 pins. The encoder you have in hand features a black, cylindrical, knurled shaft (“teeth” texture), no slot on the shaft top, and no threaded bushing for a panel nut—indicating PCB mounting rather than panel-nut mounting. Rotation has a clicky, detented feel, and pressing the shaft produces a distinct push-click.
✅ 5-pin interface: 3 pins for the encoder signals and 2 pins for the push button (PB).
🎚️ Detented rotation: Tactile clicks as you turn the shaft for step-by-step adjustments.
🔘 Push button (PB): Momentary action with a noticeable click when pressed.
⚫ Black shaft: Cylindrical, knurled (teeth-like texture) for grip; no slot on top.
🧩 No threaded bushing: Designed for PCB through‑hole mounting; secure to the PCB and, if needed, brace with the front panel.
Encoder section (3 pins): Outputs quadrature signals (A/B) relative to a common pin—used to count steps and detect direction.
Push section (2 pins): Independent momentary switch for select/confirm/enter actions.
🔌 Wiring: Use the encoder’s A and B outputs plus common to a microcontroller; wire the PB across a separate digital input and ground (or Vcc) per your design.
🧼 Debouncing: Apply hardware RC or firmware debouncing to both A/B and PB for clean counts and reliable presses.
🧲 Mounting: Since there’s no threaded bushing, mount the part flush to the PCB and support the shaft with the panel hole to avoid side-load on the bearings.
🔄 Direction: Determine rotation direction from the A/B phase relationship; each detent typically corresponds to one or more edges depending on the encoder’s internal design.

blocks.text: SUNSHINE Soldering Tip SS-210-K for T210 Handle — Knife (K) Geometry, Precision Microsoldering

The SUNSHINE SS-210-K Soldering Tip is a knife-shape (K) precision tip engineered for T210-style micro handles. With a flat, sharpened edge and stable thermal behavior, the SS-210-K excels at drag soldering fine-pitch, IC side-pin touch-ups, pad re-tinning, micro-jumper work, and solder/adhesive cleanup along frame edges or shields. If your bench runs a T210 micro handle, this is the workhorse K-blade you’ll keep docked for everyday rework.
✅ K-blade geometry: one tip covers tinning, drag soldering, point work & scraping
🎯 Fine-pitch control: stable heat at the edge for 0201/0402, QFN rims, FPC ends
🧰 T210 handle compatible: drop-in fit for T210 micro handpieces/stations
🧪 Clean wetting: iron-plated copper core for strong, consistent tinning
🔁 Fast changeover: quick swap and fast recovery on temperature
🛡️ ESD-bench friendly: suitable around sensitive electronics

🔍 Microscope comfort: thin tip silhouette keeps the working area visible.
🧩 Great with flux: pairs beautifully with no-clean flux pens for crisp drag passes.
🧰 Everyday utility: from connector pads to shield edges, it earns its place on the stand.
Drag soldering fine-pitch: QFN, PMIC edges, codec/PMU side pins.
Connector service: FPC tails, USB-C pads, board-to-board headers.

Flux first: run a no-clean flux pen along the pads to improve wetting.
Load lightly: pre-tin the K edge; for drag, keep a tiny bead leading the pass.
Angle & pressure: 15–30° to the pads, minimal pressure—let heat do the work.
Bridge removal: add flux, lower temp slightly, and wick with fresh braid.
Tip care: refresh with solder often and clean in brass wool, not a wet sponge.

microohm-109915.summary: Compact LiPo 11.1V 10400mAh 40C 3S pack delivering ~115Wh of energy and high current headroom for robotics, RC, and field rigs. Balance-charge, store at ~3.8V/cell, and design wiring for peak loads. حزمة LiPo 11.1V 10400mAh 40C مدمجة بطاقة ~115Wh وقدرة تيار عالية للتطبيقات الروبوتية وRC والمعدات الميدانية. اشحن بموازنة وخزّن عند ~3.8V/خلية وصمّم الأسلاك لتحمل الذروات.

blocks.text: Meet the dependable high-capacity pack that delivers serious current without drama. The LiPo 11.1V 10400mAh 40C configuration balances runtime, punch, and compactness for demanding builds that need clean power on tap. From mobile robotics to field instruments and FPV ground systems, this pack is designed to supply a steady bus at 3S nominal while handling aggressive transient loads with low sag.
✅ High energy + stable bus — 11.1V nominal (3S) with ~115.4Wh of stored energy (10.4Ah × 11.1V) to extend missions and sessions without frequent swaps.

⚡ Serious discharge headroom — 40C continuous translates to up to 416A potential current (theoretical; size wiring and protection accordingly) to cover spikes from motors, RF finals, DC-DC inrush, and servo bursts.
🧠 Pack intelligence ready — Simple two-lead main output plus a balance header for cell-level maintenance and health checks with common hobby-grade chargers and analyzers.
🔒 Safety-first design practice — Robust shrink wrap, cell spacing, and vent path planning recommended in the bay; label windows allow quick identification for field crews and pilots.
🧰 Integration friendly — Fits typical 3S rails and power trees; easy to pair with 5V/12V buck converters, telemetry modules, and smart BMS add-ons.
🛠️ Serviceable lifecycle — Routine balance charging and storage-voltage discipline help preserve capacity across seasons.
🌡️ Thermal resilience workflow — Plan airflow around the pack; add temperature probes near the core during system validation to keep cell temps in the green under peak draw.
🔄 Repeatable deployment — Color-coded leads, protective caps, and strap-through mounting points support fast changeovers on carts, rigs, and drones.
🔌 Autonomous mobile robots (AMR/UGV) — Smooth supply for motor controllers, compute modules, depth cams, and radios.
🎥 Cine/field rigs — Feed monitors, wireless video, encoders, and follow-focus with a compact 3S bus and external regulators.
🛰️ Comms & test benches — RF amplifiers, SDR front-ends, and field diagnostics where a quiet DC source matters.
🚤 Surface/air RC platforms — Boats, planes, and large gliders that prefer 3S with plenty of surge capacity for takeoff and maneuvers.
🧪 STEM / lab builds — Capstone power plants for cap-rail experiments, mechatronics, and embedded systems.
✅ Wire gauge & connectors — Size main leads for worst-case continuous current with margin; keep harness runs short to minimize voltage drop.
✅ Mounting — Use wide straps or foam rails; avoid hard edges and fastener heads that can abrade the wrap under vibration.
✅ Redundancy — For mission-critical platforms, consider parallel packs with diodes or ideal-OR controllers and per-leg fusing.
✅ Telemetry — Add voltage and temperature telemetry on-board; set alerts conservatively to protect cells under dynamic loads.
✅ Balance discipline — Balance-charge regularly; investigate any cell that lags by >30–50mV after a proper rest period.
⚠️ Charge in a fire-resistant enclosure on a non-flammable surface; never leave unattended.
⚠️ Use a compatible balance charger set to 3S LiPo chemistry and correct capacity settings; inspect leads before connecting.
⚠️ Storage around 3.75–3.85V per cell for extended shelf life; check monthly and top up if needed.
⚠️ Temperature — Avoid charging below 0 °C or above 45 °C; keep operation within a sensible thermal envelope.
⚠️ Physical integrity — Retire packs that show swelling, puncture, odor, or recurring imbalance.
Energy: ~115.4 Wh provides, for example, ~2.3 hours at 50 W or ~1.0 hour at 110 W (not accounting for converter losses).
Current headroom: 40C on 10.4Ah → 416A theoretical; design continuous draw far lower with appropriate protection and thermal design.
Converters: Pair with high-efficiency buck/boost modules for 5V, 9V, or 12V rails; validate transient response with your load profile.
Balance lead: 3S balance header (typical for cell maintenance)
Basic use & care label: Quick reminders for charge, storage, and disposal
For best results, log per-cycle capacity, IR, and peak temps; trend these to make proactive replacement decisions in fleets.
🧷 Securement — Dual straps, non-slip mat, and corner padding.
🧯 Containment — Add a fire-resistant sleeve or bay partition in sensitive platforms.
🔁 Connect-disconnect routine — Power down loads before removing the pack; avoid arcing on high-current connectors.
🧪 Bring-up tests — Step-load testing from idle to surge; record bus sag and pack temps to set thermal limits.
🧲 EMI hygiene — Twist high-current pairs; route away from sensors/radios; add LC filtering if needed.
Fast voltage drop under load → Check harness resistance, connector health, and cell balance.
Charger won’t start → Verify balance plug seating and correct 3S profile.
Warm pack at light loads → Evaluate airflow and conversion losses; test for a weak cell.
Early cutoff → Confirm cutoff thresholds in ESC/BMS and recalibrate fuel-gauge assumptions.
♻️ Discharge to a safe level and follow local e-waste procedures. Isolate terminals.
Also known as: 3S LiPo, 11.1V LiPo, 10.4Ah LiPo, 40C pack, RC LiPo, high-discharge 3S battery.

✅ طاقة عالية وجهد مستقر — جهد اسمي 11.1V مع طاقة مخزنة تقارب 115.4Wh لزمن تشغيل أطول وتقليل عمليات الاستبدال.

blocks.text: Water Turbidity Sensor Module (Probe + Signal Board, 5V, Analog & Digital Output)

Meet the Water Turbidity Sensor Module—a compact, plug-and-play kit that combines an infrared optical probe with a conditioning board to read the clarity of water in real time. Designed around an IR emitter and a matched phototransistor, the sensor measures the light scattered by suspended particles and converts it to a clean voltage level your controller can understand. Whether you’re tracking filter performance, automating aquarium maintenance, logging environmental data, or building a classroom experiment, this module delivers repeatable results with minimal setup.
🔌 Drop-in wiring: 3-wire probe into the board; board provides VCC, GND, AO (analog), DO (digital) to your microcontroller.
⚙️ Two outputs: Read fine-grained analog voltage for calibration or use digital threshold via an onboard comparator (potentiometer adjustable).
🧪 Reliable optical design: IR LED (emitter) + phototransistor geometry reduces color sensitivity and ambient-light effects for stable readings.
🧩 Broad compatibility: Works with Arduino, ESP32/ESP8266, STM32, Raspberry Pi (via ADC), PLCs with 0–5 V inputs, and common data loggers.
💧 Ready for real water: Encapsulated probe head tolerates continuous contact with water; ideal for aquariums, hydroponics, RO/DI monitoring, and lab demos.
🔧 Onboard trim: Set the turbidity trip point for the digital output using the multi-turn potentiometer; onboard LED indicates state at a glance.
📊 Calibratable response: Map voltage to NTU using your own clear/standard samples for best accuracy (application note below).
🧠 Noise-reduced signal chain: Low-ripple 5 V operation and analog filtering provide stable readings even with long sample tubes.
🧴 Compact probe: Round housing with bayonet-style collar makes panel mounting straightforward; see mechanical drawing below.
🧷 Fail-safe wiring labels: Probe pins are molded and labeled VCC / TR / IR on the head for easy verification during assembly.
🧊 Optical turbidity probe (blue collar, translucent head)
🟦 Signal conditioning module (AO/DO outputs, trim pot, indicator LED)
🪢 3-core lead between probe and board (assumption: 20–30 cm; confirm as needed)
✨ IR emission: The IR LED sends light through the water sample.
🛰️ Scatter collection: Suspended particles scatter light toward the phototransistor.
🔄 Proportional signal: More particles → more scatter → higher sensor current → a higher AO voltage (after conditioning).
🚦 Thresholding: The onboard comparator compares AO to your setpoint to drive DO high/low for simple on/off logic and alarms.
🐠 Aquariums & aquatic farms: filter clogging detection, water change timing
🥬 Hydroponics & nutrient tanks: clarity tracking after dosing
🧪 Education & STEM labs: optics, scattering, environmental science

🌿 Environmental sampling (rivers, ponds) with portable data loggers

🧾 Internal layout: Left cavity = IR Emitting Diode; right cavity = TR (Photo-Transistor). Connector at base labeled VCC / TR / IR for the head.

🎚️ Digital output (DO): TTL-level, active on threshold; adjustable via potentiometer
🎯 Recommended turbidity range: 0–1000 NTU usable; 0–3000 NTU extended with custom calibration (assumption; set by application)
🔁 Repeatability: good with stable temperature and supply; use averaging for best results
🚿 Fluid compatibility: Freshwater; non-corrosive, non-solvent liquids. Avoid hot, viscous, or solvent media.

🔌 Power the Water Turbidity Sensor Module at 5 V.
🟢 Connect AO to an analog pin (A0).
🟣 Optionally connect DO to a digital pin (D2) for alarm/threshold.
🎚️ Place the probe into your water sample; wait 3–5 s for stabilization.
🧭 Turn the potentiometer until the onboard LED toggles at your desired clarity.
📊 Read AO values, average (e.g., 10–50 samples), and map to NTU using your calibration curve.
🌫️ Reference points: Use clear water (0 NTU proxy) and a known turbidity standard (e.g., 100–500 NTU for your range).
📐 Curve fitting: Record AO for each reference; fit a 2-point linear or polynomial curve to convert AO→NTU.
🔁 Stability: Keep temperature, container geometry, and immersion depth consistent between measurements.
🧼 Maintenance: Rinse after each use; avoid fingerprints or film on the optical windows.
🚫 Not for hot liquids, solvents, or strong acids/alkalis.
🧯 Observe correct polarity; reverse connection may damage the IR LED.
🧽 Keep the optical windows clean; deposits cause drift.

microohm-40647.summary: Arduino UNO R4 Minima Improved Version Type-C Made In China

blocks.text: Arduino UNO R4 Minima Improved Version Type-C Made In China

Arduino empowers makers’ creativity and passion for innovation with a robust new board that’s perfect for all users, from beginners to experts – allowing anyone to easily connect to the internet and create IoT projects.

Your user-friendly, accessible UNO just took a quantum leap forward: Arduino UNO R4 is a 32-bit microprocessor offering more speed, memory, connectors and connectivity options than any version of the board before. Out of this world, and into the future.

Arduino’s continued commitment to making technology accessible to everyone was the inspiration behind Arduino UNO R4 Minima: the new addition to the brand’s community-supported ecosystem offers powerful technology at an affordable price. Packing more computational power, memory and speed in the familiar form factor of the UNO at 5V operating voltage, it allows users to easily upgrade projects made with the UNO R3 or the Leonardo. What’s more, thanks to a RA4M1 microcontroller by Renesas, it can leverage two new off-the-shelf peripherals, CAN BUS and (12 bit) DAC: perfect for automation or audio projects.

UNO R4 Minima is armed with a powerful 32-bit microcontroller courtesy of Renesas. Brace yourself for increased processing power, expanded memory, and a whole new level of on-board peripherals. The best part? Compatibility with existing shields and accessories remains intact, and there’s no need to make any changes to the standard form factor or 5 V operating voltage.
Features of Arduino Uno R4 Minima (Clone)
Hardware compatibility with UNO form factor, 5 V operating voltage, as the UNO R3. Compatible with existing shields and projects
The UNO R4 Minima introduces a range of on-board peripherals, including a 12-bit DAC, CAN BUS, and OP AMP
The UNO R4 Minima now supports a wider input voltage range, allowing power supplies up to 24 V
SWD connector, Simply connect an external debugger and effortlessly monitor the inner workings of your code and hardware
HID support: The UNO R4 Minima comes with built-in HID (Human Interface Device) support, enabling it to simulate a mouse or keyboard
Specification of Arduino Uno R4 Minima (Clone)
Memory: RA4M1 : 256 KB Flash, 32 KB RAM, 8 KB Data Memory (EEPROM)
Barrel jack connected to VIN pin (6-24 V)
